descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: cloud speech-to-text gating and a 429.

Bug B27 · S2 · new (partly known)

Failure states give the wrong or no guidance: after an interrupted pre-round save the Encounter tab keeps the physician waiting for the panels while the Pre-Round tab says to tap Save Note; an interrupted Nursing Home Save Note says the text was edited; a red 'disconnected' error stays after dictation recovered; a failed Quick Dictation transcription shows only the raw server error, no '⚠ what to do'; with the microphone blocked it still says 'Dictation done — review before saving'; Post-Round shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' forever for a Hospital patient with no note yet

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745/92582): EFS/S06: the Encounter tab does say the panels are still being processed; the fault is that the processing had stopped. TC-04/S28: on a 429 the only thing on screen is the raw server error (B17's kind), and S28 covers only the batch (whisper) path, not a gpt-live failure. EFS/S22: 'Dictation done' with the microphone blocked (UAT state 8). EFS/S02 and TC-20/S24: the endless 'Finalizing…' spinner D7 points to.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S06, TC-10/S29, TC-23/S08, EFS/S17, TC-17/S19

Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S28 Cloud speech-to-text into a box (transcribeAudio mocked): text lands word for word only after 'Transcribing…'; a 429 keeps the box and says so

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 step 1)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 5; TFA-92582 step 5; TFA-92583 AC 4)
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 2; TFA-92583 AC 2)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given QA Hosp Patel (415); an account on the cloud engine (not ON_DEVICE_TEST_ENGINE); Chromium with a fake microphone; ai/transcribe:transcribeAudio answered through action-observer: first a held reply with the transcript below, then a rejection with a 429 'credit_balance_exhausted' error (as on dev, 2026-10-09)

When Dictate into an empty box, tap Stop, try Assign and Link while 'Transcribing…' shows, let the reply land, tap Link. Then dictate into a box that already holds 'Bed 415, stable.' and tap Stop while transcribeAudio rejects

Then Success: Assign and Link disabled while 'Transcribing…' shows; the box then holds the transcript word for word; after Link the chart holds it exactly. Failure: a visible '⚠' message; the box still holds 'Bed 415, stable.'; no 'Transcribing…' left and Assign to patient enabled within the capture ceiling (CAPTURE_CEILING_MS, 60 s); nothing reaches the chart

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: buttons disabled during 'Transcribing…' (U2: never placed half-heard); textarea toHaveValue(transcript) and encounterNotes toBe(transcript) (U2 verbatim, 3.4); on the 429, a message starting with '⚠' visible, textarea toHaveValue('Bed 415, stable.') (U4 never silently dropped), 'Assign to patient' enabled within 60 s (3.5 never left waiting with nothing) …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection (FAULT (transcribeAudio mocked: held reply, then 429)); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
